sentences.en: One-third of an apple is always given to our youngest daughter.
sentences.zh: 这颗苹果的三分之一总是被分给我们的小女儿。

sentences.en: Ceres contains one-third of the mass found in the asteroid belt.
sentences.zh: 谷神星包含小行星带中发现的质量的三分之一。

sentences.en: The circulation of the newspaper is only one-third that of its competitor.
sentences.zh: 该报纸的发行量只有竞争对手的三分之一。
